seal.statement: A services row whose address is not a unified address must not raise an untyped failure in peer admission. Quest learner-host-from-committed-admission made the admission derive the committed node by parsing the row's address, and on PR #184's gate 41482547014 a row with address ws://localhost:<port>/partition/<id> threw MalformedAddressError out of the reconcile setImmediate hop (test/integration/services-p1-self-referential-write.integration.test.js), where main answers a typed outcome. An unparsable address now resolves to no node, so the admission reaches the port's one typed refusal for an ADD that names no node (RAFT_MEMBERSHIP_CHANGE_REFUSAL.WITHOUT_NODE_ID), reconcile treats it as unadmitted and records it, for the partition and the message group alike; a founding cohort with such a row records no node for that founder instead of throwing.
